name: Stinglasher
summary: In the Writhing Deep, Hadoken Swiftstrider's scout has found an insect far larger than the others.

sections.title: A Giant Among the Insects
sections.body: A scout has found a giant insect wandering the twisted terrain of the Writhing Deep. It seems to give off an aura unlike the others, and Hadoken Swiftstrider has named it Stinglasher. Hadoken wants its secretion glands brought straight to Camp Mojache. By studying the insect's innards, Hadoken hopes to learn how to deal with this new threat.

sections.title: Hadoken's Thanks
sections.body: Hadoken Swiftstrider is impressed by your work. If Stinglasher is among the strongest insects, studying it may prove valuable. Hadoken must keep the camp defended long enough to benefit. In thanks from the whole camp, Hadoken gives you a coin bounty.

faq.answer: Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache in Feralas sends you after Stinglasher.
Stinglasher wanders the twisted terrain of the Writhing Deep.

faq.q: What makes Stinglasher different from the other insects?
faq.answer: A scout reports that Stinglasher is far larger than the other insects and seems to give off an aura they lack.

faq.q: Why does Hadoken want Stinglasher's glands?
faq.answer: Hadoken wants Stinglasher's glands so its innards can be studied while a plan against this new threat is worked out.
